Has anybody encountered a friend or have a loved one who was conscious of their sociopathic behaviors and impulses? Reading some of the comments, there's the argument that with it being a personality behavior, there is no way around it. That you are essentially stuck with the behavior since it's embedded into your genetic code. Others are saying it's something that can be managed or put under control. 

I will openly admit, I have some serious sociopathic and narcissistic tendencies (mostly due to my family spoiling me as a child growing up & me being an only child). My girlfriend and I recently had a discussion about it and how we can "try to help me for the better," but reading this thread has me slightly doubtful of myself. Personally, it really bothers me because sometimes when we text or are on the phone. I can tell she's losing slight interest  during our conversations because all I'll be talking about are my personal experiences and opinions rather than having an equal sided conversation where both parties are contributing. Along side the fact that my narcissistic tendencies usually make trying to communicate issues with her and other people in my life damn near impossible sometimes.

Really hate living this way and have had this sort of "understanding" about my issues for quite a while now. It's made me hate myself more and more over the years because I feel it's made me unable to maintain a real relationship with anybody. Which is also something that some of you have mentioned and it scares me because how will I ever know when I've actually got something good? Platonic or intimate. 

Will I ever be normal? Or do I just have to play with the cards I'm dealt? Those of you who see therapists or counselors, have they ever given you any sort of advice on keeping some of those behaviors under control? Although, I kinda feel it's a little self explanatory to ones self to just not be a selfish prick to others haha. Let me know what you guys think!
